title.value: Conditional Image Generation by Conditioning Variational Auto-Encoders
title.justification: The title of the paper directly from the first page of the PDF document.
title.quote: Conditional Image Generation by Conditioning Variational Auto-Encoders

analysis.description: This paper proposes a new method for conditional image generation utilizing a pre-trained unconditional variational auto-encoder (VAE). The authors focus on image inpainting and demonstrate their model's ability to outperform state-of-the-art GAN-based methods in certain respects, particularly in representing inherent uncertainty. The approach highlights a method to convert pretrained VAEs into conditional VAEs, enabling faster and more efficient training processes. Moreover, the paper explores an application in Bayesian experimental design, showcasing practical implementations of their architecture.

type.justification: The paper contains empirical experiments that demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method on various tasks such as image completion on datasets like CIFAR-10, ImageNet-64, and FFHQ-256.
type.quote: We demonstrate our approach on tasks including image inpainting, for which it outperforms state-of-the-art GAN-based approaches at faithfully representing the inherent uncertainty.

name.justification: The research work primarily deals with issues related to image data and proposes solutions involving image inpainting, a well-known problem in the field of computer vision.
name.quote: We focus on the problem of conditional generative modelling: given an input (e.g. a partially blanked-out image), we wish to map to a distribution over outputs (e.g. plausible completions of the image).

name.justification: The main focus of the paper is on the development of a conditional image generation model using VAEs.
name.quote: We present a conditional variational auto-encoder (VAE)... We demonstrate our approach on tasks including image inpainting, for which it outperforms state-of-the-art GAN-based approaches at faithfully representing the inherent uncertainty.

name.justification: The paper discusses the use of their approach in Bayesian experimental design, specifically to guide sensor operations.
name.quote: We conclude by describing a possible application of our inpainting model, in which it is used to perform Bayesian experimental design for the purpose of guiding a sensor.

name.justification: The paper introduces a conditional version of VAEs as a primary contribution and demonstrates their application in conditional image generation tasks.
name.quote: We present a conditional variational auto-encoder (VAE)...to leverage a foundation model in the form of a pretrained unconditional VAE.

is_contributed.justification: The model is a novel contribution of the paper, introduced and developed by the authors.
is_contributed.quote: We present a conditional variational auto-encoder (VAE)...

is_executed.justification: The model was executed in various experiments showing image inpainting performance.
is_executed.quote: We demonstrate our approach on tasks including image inpainting...

is_compared.justification: The paper includes comparisons of the conditional VAE model with GANs and other state-of-the-art models for image generation.
is_compared.quote: We compare against four baselines: Co-Modulated Generative Adversarial Networks (CoModGAN), Pluralistic Image Completion (PIC), Context Encoders (CE), and Attentive Neural Processes (ANP).

name.justification: The paper discusses the use of pretrained unconditional VAEs as the basis for building conditional VAEs.
name.quote: We design the architecture so that we can incorporate pretrained unconditional VAEs.

is_contributed.justification: Unconditional VAEs themselves are not a contribution of the paper; it builds on existing models.
is_contributed.quote: The unconditional VAE need not have been (pre-)trained on the same dataset as the conditional model; we show un- conditional models trained on ImageNet are suitable for later use with various photo datasets.

is_executed.justification: While the weights from these models are utilized, the model itself is not directly executed as a part of the paper's primary experiments.
is_executed.quote: Most of the unconditional VAEs in our experiments use publicly- available pretrained weights released by Child (2020).

is_compared.justification: The unconditional VAEs are not directly compared to other models; rather, their pretrained weights are used to enhance conditional VAEs.
is_compared.quote: While requiring an existing pretrained model is a limitation, we note that: (I) The unconditional VAE need not have been (pre-)trained on the same dataset as the conditional model; we show un- conditional models trained on ImageNet are suitable for later use with various photo datasets.
